Setup 离线包失败时跳过 Melon，避免半成品 Loader；cpp2il-plugin 补全 originUrl；Melon CLI 播种失败返回 exit 6；简中走 COS，其它语言走 origin。
Setup skips Melon when redist ensure fails to avoid a half-installed Loader; cpp2il-plugin has originUrl; Melon CLI returns exit 6 on seed failure; zh-CN uses COS, other languages use origin.
